statementEvidence.reviewNote: N<=100 distinct six-sided dice; sum the product of outcomes over all6^N outcome tuples modulo1e9+7.

solutionEvidence.reviewNote: Distributivity factors the sum of all products into the product of per-die face sums. Process each die once, O(6N), with modular multiplication. This is a sum, not an expectation, so no division by6^N.
